data.name: Ankush Regundwar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ankush Regundwar has made a big mark in cricket. With 83 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 52*, with an average of 10.65 and a quick strike rate of 114.98. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 16 sixes and 70 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 216.1 overs, taking 101 wickets at an economy rate of 8.87. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
